text:
Roman Josi turned 36 in June and is still logging 25.6 minutes a night for Nashville, with 23 points in 22 games. He has 21 assists and two goals, and that split tells you most of what is going on. The Predators' captain keeps getting good looks: 4.3 expected goals (the quality of his chances) on 60 shots. Shooting 3.3% will not last for a defenseman with his release, and our numbers flag him as due.

The other flag points the opposite way. Nashville has scored 5.3 more goals than its chances deserve with him on the ice, which is padding the assist total. Put the two together and his overall pace (2.45 points per 60, just above our 1.69 to 2.30 range) looks only a little high.

He did produce the moment of the Predators' week: the shootout winner in Vegas on Nov. 13 for their seventh straight win, as TSN and others reported. Two losses followed, including 7-3 in Minnesota. Corey Sznajder's All Three Zones tracking has him carrying the puck in on 44% of his entries, which is where his offense still starts.
headline: Josi is setting up everyone but himself
